pages.raw_title: Kadant Inc. - A Global Leader in Technology And Engineered Systems
pages.raw_meta: Kadant Inc. is a global supplier of high-value, engineered systems used in process industries worldwide.
raw_blocks: A Global Leader in Technology & Engineered Systems that Drive

We are a global supplier of technologies and engineered systems that drive Sustainable Industrial Processing®. Our products and services play an integral role in enhancing efficiency, optimizing energy utilization, and maximizing productivity in process industries.
Custom-engineered products, systems, and technologies used to enable fluid, power, and data transfer to optimize energy utilization, improve machine runnability, and enhance productivity.
Machinery and engineered systems and components to help customers maximize the production of fiber-based, renewable products.
Products and systems used to handle bulk and discrete materials for secondary processing.

From paper and packaging to wood products, mining, food processing, and energy, Kadant delivers engineered systems and technologies purpose-built for the demands of global process industries. Explore how our expertise and solutions are put to work across the markets we serve.
Explore our family of companies to learn how each one delivers specialized expertise and proven solutions to process industries around the world.

Our products are designed to reduce waste, use resources more efficiently, and allow our customers to create more value with fewer inputs. We do this with integrity, a commitment to ethics, and responsible operations.

Kadant's automation portfolio — illumen.X, PaperFront®, and Vayeron Asset Performance Monitoring — gives process industries the digital tools to optimize performance, predict equipment failures, and build data-driven operations from plant floor to enterprise.
We work to envision the future and create value through discovering and applying innovations that address industrial processing challenges while extending our depth of technology.

pages.raw_meta: Kadant Inc. is a global supplier of high-value, engineered systems used in process industries worldwide.
raw_blocks: Our Flow Control segment consists of our Fluid Handling and Doctoring, Cleaning & Filtration product lines, delivering custom-engineered products, systems, and technologies that keep critical industrial and commercial processes running efficiently across packaging, tissue, food processing, metals, and other demanding sectors.

Our brand portfolio carries a rich heritage of product innovation since 1880, with well-known industry names including AES, Johnson, Lodding, Unaflex, and Vickery. Our primary products include rotary sealing devices, steam systems, expansion joints, doctor systems, roll and fabric cleaning devices, and filtration and fiber recovery systems. With deep application expertise and a proven track record, we help customers reduce energy consumption, improve machine runnability, and build long-term operational sustainability.
Packaging, Paper, Tissue, and Pulp

Kadant’s fluid handling products and technologies are used to control the flow of fluids in process industries worldwide. These products include rotary joints and unions, expansion joints, condensate pumps, thermocompressors, desuperheaters, and direct steam injection heaters.

Kadant’s wide range of doctoring, cleaning, and filtration systems and related consumables are used in process industries worldwide. These products include doctor blades and holders, roll cleaning blades and holders, spray nozzles, oscillating showers, and fabric and belt cleaning systems.

DSTI is a leader in engineered fluid sealing and transfer solutions for rotating applications, serving a wide range of global industries. Its products include fluid rotary unions, electrical slip rings, and custom-engineered solutions designed and manufactured to meet the precise requirements of aerospace, defense, medical, semiconductor, machine tool, and industrial applications.

pages.raw_meta: Kadant Inc. is a global supplier of high-value, engineered systems used in process industries worldwide.
raw_blocks: For more than a century, Kadant has been delivering smart and efficient solutions to process industries.

We are a global supplier of technologies and engineered systems that drive Sustainable Industrial Processing® . Our products and services play an integral role in enhancing efficiency, optimizing energy utilization, and maximizing productivity in process industries while helping our customers advance their sustainability initiatives with products that reduce waste or generate more yield with fewer inputs, particularly fiber, energy, and water.

Our major product brands, many of which are sold under the Kadant name through our subsidiaries, include well-known industry names such as AES, Balemaster, Black Clawson (stock preparation), Carmanah, Clouth, Goslin, Johnson, Lamort, Link-Belt, Lodding, Nicholson Manufacturing, Noss, PAAL, Syntron, Unaflex, Valon Kone, and Vickery.
Fiber processing systems for recovering recycled fibers and processing virgin fibers
Fluid handling systems and engineered products that transfer fluid, power, and data between fixed piping and rotating components
Roll doctoring and scraping products that clean roll surfaces
Cleaning and filtration systems that clean fabrics and filter and recycle process water
Wood processing systems to debark and cut logs into strands, and knife systems for chipping, planing, and flaking used in the production of OSB, lumber, and other wood-based products
Baling equipment and systems to process recyclable waste and other materials for transport and storage
Bulk material handling equipment for conveying, feeding, screening, and elevating material
Boiler cleaning technologies that maximize equipment reliability and minimize operational costs in cellulose pulp-making processes
Single- and double-screw presses that remove water and other liquids from sugar beet pulp, cellulose pulp, and other agro-industrial products
Customized rolled profiles and industrial knife solutions engineered for demanding industrial applications
Kadant Inc. is based in Westford, Massachusetts, with approximately 3,900 employees in 22 countries worldwide. Our stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol KAI.
Kadant brand products and services are sold to industries worldwide through our subsidiaries located in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia.
